verdict.rationale: LobeChat is an agent collaboration platform where users hand work to built-in Agents. The vendor documents scheduled tasks that Agents handle, auto team formation that assembles Agents for a task, and a Home dashboard showing what Agents are still running and what they did while you were away. Onboarding also suggests starter Tasks and sets up agents from one sentence. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works reliably, and in-depth docs on task execution and monitoring beyond changelog and marketing snippets.
